decisions.reason: It is close to the firm’s core formwork and factory-equipment knowledge and the firm’s own R&D and growth orientation make continued learning and incremental improvement likely.

Because it is closely related to the established offer, the firm can absorb market feedback and refine it, although its lower website prominence suggests it may be somewhat less strategic than the flagship additions.
This product fits the firm’s existing modular formwork competence very well, and the firm’s in-house R&D supports keeping and developing such adjacent innovations.

The product is still within the firm’s knowledge base and therefore likely to be retained, but its more limited website presence points to a slightly higher chance of rationalisation than the more prominently presented items.
